meta.title: Best Seafood Buffet in Da Nang! 🇻🇳 All You Can Eat Seafood Restaurant in Vietnam!
meta.description:
Best Seafood Buffet in Da Nang Vietnam! 

If you're a seafood lover visiting Da Nang, Vietnam, this buffet might be one of the most exciting dining experiences in the city.

In today’s episode, we visit All Seasons Buffet, a popular all-you-can-eat à la carte seafood buffet where every dish is freshly cooked and brought directly to your table. Instead of a traditional buffet line, you simply order from the menu and enjoy premium seafood dishes made to order.

The highlight of this experience is the lobster served three different ways, such as lobster baked with truffle and cheese, grilled with garlic butter, and wok-fried with Hoi An chili sauce. But the seafood feast doesn’t stop there.

During this epic buffet experience we also try:
• A towering seafood platter
• Fresh oysters and cheesy clams
• Giant river prawns and crab
• Stir-fried octopus with garlic
• Seafood pizza and crispy pork belly
• Fresh sashimi and carpaccio
• And an incredible dessert selection including crepe suzette, tiramisu, and coffee jelly

The restaurant also offers multiple pricing packages, including options with half lobster, whole lobster, or even unlimited lobster.

If you enjoy buffets, seafood, and food adventures around the world, be sure to subscribe for more episodes.

Location: 
📍  All Seasons Buffet: https://maps.app.goo.gl/iM5j7FY8fSv8YEf58
